title: AI Image Enhancement Improves Flip-Chip Defect Detection
summary: Researchers demonstrated that AI-based image enhancement improves the detection of interconnect defects and cracks in microelectronic packaging.

title: 3D Integration Lowers Emissions of GPU Scaling
summary: Researchers modeled how 2.5D and 3D scaling in chipletized GPUs can reduce the embodied carbon emissions impact of AI data centers.

title: Meter-Scale Quantum Interconnects Link 120-Qubit Processors
summary: IBM Research demonstrated meter-scale quantum interconnects capable of linking large individual quantum processor modules.

title: APPlace Co-Optimizes Device Locations for Analog Placement
summary: Researchers published an analog layout automation approach that co-optimizes device locations and access points for routing-aware placement.

title: New Electronic Implant Lowers Blood Sugar and Weight
summary: Researchers developed an electronic implant that uses an electric catalyst to convert excess glucose in diabetic mice into a substance eliminated through urine.

title: Andes Puts Cuzco RISC-V CPU on Back Burner
summary: Andes CTO Charlie Su announced the company has delayed commercial rollout of its high-end RISC-V CPU due to market conditions.

title: Shift Left Becomes a System-Level Design Challenge
summary: Increased complexity is forcing engineers to validate hardware, software, and physical constraints earlier in the design flow.

title: Finer Energy-Group Structure Improves SpecKit Neutron Spectrum Unfolding
summary: A study demonstrates that adopting finer energy-group structures within the SpecKit framework reduces activity errors and enhances reconstruction fidelity in neutron spectrum unfolding.

title: Scientists Develop Tech to Transmit Smells Over the Internet
summary: Scientists have figured out a way to transmit smells over the internet.

title: Satellites Track Fireballs to Boost Planetary Defense
summary: Military and civil satellites are monitoring fireballs in Earth's atmosphere to help improve planetary defense against space debris impacts.

title: VicOne Finds 28 Zero-Day Vulnerabilities Using AI
summary: VicOne identified 28 zero-day findings in less than two days using AI-assisted research across physical AI software and tools.

title: Combating Semiconductor Obsolescence in Long-Life Systems
summary: Engineers protect long-life systems from semiconductor obsolescence using critical-parts planning, authorized sourcing, and early dialogue.

title: NASA's Swift Space Telescope Prepares to Re-enter Earth
summary: Researchers are closely monitoring the upcoming deorbit and plunge of the Swift observatory back to Earth.

title: Archimedes' Screw Shrunk to Molecular Scale
summary: Scientists have built a molecular motor inspired by Archimedes' screw that uses electricity to spin and increase conductivity.

title: Focused Ultrasound Used to Fight Brain Cancer
summary: Researchers combined focused ultrasound, nanoparticles, and microRNAs to attack glioblastoma brain cancer cells.

title: Kawasaki Introduces KLE650 Middleweight Adventure Tourer
summary: Kawasaki has expanded its motorcycle lineup with the new KLE650, a middleweight model designed for long-distance touring comfort.

title: Estimating Geotechnical Parameters via Electrical Resistivity Tomography
summary: Researchers combined electrical resistivity tomography with core drilling and lab testing to estimate subsoil geotechnical parameters in Morocco.

title: Receptive English Proficiency Across Engineering Programs
summary: A study of Vietnamese engineering students revealed a consistent proficiency hierarchy across different academic program types and cohorts.

title: Uncertainty Modeling of Mechanical Properties in Warm Frozen Clay
summary: Researchers used copula theory to investigate the dependence between strength and elastic modulus in warm frozen soil for roadbed stability.

title: Automated Gravel Transport Measurement Using Impact Plates
summary: Stainless-steel impact plates equipped with accelerometers were installed in a watershed to automate the measurement of gravel transport.

title: Bearing Capacity Prediction for Foundations in Rock Slopes
summary: A novel finite-element limit analysis software was developed to assess end bearing capacity for foundations in Hoek-Brown rock slopes.

title: Comparative Impacts of Algal Biomass on Potato Purée
summary: Researchers characterized the fortification effects of various algal biomass types on the rheological and physical properties of potato purée.

title: Structural Optimization of a Downward Air Duct Dust Collector
summary: Computational fluid dynamics simulations were used to optimize partition plates and tube sheet structures for improved dust collector flow uniformity.

title: Trust-Aware Framework for Sparse Mobile Crowdsensing
summary: A reinforcement learning-based framework was proposed to optimize data collection and inference accuracy while filtering out untrustworthy workers.

title: Device Bias Instability in Scaled Oxide Semiconductor 2T0C DRAM
summary: Researchers studied bias instability in BEOL-compatible oxide semiconductor transistors to improve 2T0C DRAM retention and circuit reliability.

title: Applied Game for Spatial Audio in Mobile XR
summary: An applied game using hardware LiDAR sensors and real-time sound spatialisation was developed to simplify spatial audio deployment in mobile XR.

title: Smart IoT Objects Infer Human Spatial Reasoning
summary: A new proof-of-concept system uses smart IoT objects to monitor physical interactions and quantitatively infer human spatial reasoning.

title: Supervised ML Improves SDN Traffic Classification
summary: Combining supervised machine learning models with software-defined networking architecture achieves high-accuracy traffic classification for quality of service management.

title: Earth Pressure Analysis for Pit-Retaining Structures
summary: An integrated theoretical and numerical study investigates earth pressure against pit-retaining structures rotating around lateral supports with log-spiral failure surfaces.

title: Repairable Steel Beam-Column Connection with Perforated Plates
summary: A novel steel connection featuring peanut-shaped perforated flange cover plates improves seismic performance and energy dissipation.
